solar_source: NASA POWER / CERES hourly satellite/model assimilation

unresolved_interval_issue.issue: NASA POWER hourly fluxes represent 60-minute time-integrated energy values. The provider label '2024041509' does not declare whether the window is [08:00, 09:00] UTC (hour-ending), [09:00, 10:00] UTC (hour-beginning), or [08:30, 09:30] UTC (hour-centered).
unresolved_interval_issue.impact: Pairing time-integrated radiation with instantaneous solar geometry (altitude ~52.8 deg, azimuth ~264.4 deg) at 09:00 UTC introduces solar position discrepancy.

solar_azimuth_grid_convergence_impact.note: Radiation solver rays must be computed using Grid North azimuth in UTM Zone 43N space.
